description: Nish, a statically compiled TypeScript subset, on its standard library's nish/net/http-server: one process a core under nish/net/prefork, pinned, each on one poll loop over a kernel-steered SO_REUSEPORT listener. HTTP/1.1 on 8080 and h2c on 8082 through the same server and router; JSON written by JsonWriter on every request and gzipped through nish/net/http-compress; Postgres through nish/net/postgres.
